headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2020, back when a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Omega & Page vs. SCU (Kaz & Sky) battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.91 ? a match that delivered ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Omega & Page's career. Taped aboard a literal cruise ship on the high seas, this was AEW's first-ever title change ? Page dragged an exhausted Omega to safety and single-handedly finished off both champions with back-to-back Buckshot Lariats, laying bare the growing tension between the two.

That Wednesday in 2025, there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as The Hurt Syndicate vs. Private Party battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.83 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. For The Hurt Syndicate, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. The Hurt Syndicate put Isiah Kassidy through the announce table before a Bobby Lashley spear ended Private Party's three-month tag title reign.
On this day in 2020, Jon Moxley vs. PAC met in a Number One Contender, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.81, part of the special Bash at the Beach '20 - Night 2 card.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2020, Ortiz & Santana & Jericho left that name behind for good, stepping out as Proud-N-Powerful & Jericho after 1 match under the old identity, on Dynamite.
Looking back to 2020, when Priscilla Kelly arrived in AEW against Britt Baker, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.53.
Back on this day in 2025, it was a welcome sight as AR Fox returned to the ring after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
